123183.synopsis:
Failing her graduation exam, Dania Lancaster, a theology student at the Academy, found herself drinking consolation drinks with her childhood friend, Luel.
Dania, who was diligent and studious, couldn’t help but think about the rumors surrounding Luel, who was said to live a debauched life with his noble friends.
That night, an overly drunk Dania provoked him, claiming, ‘There’s no way someone like you could be good at… nighttime activities.’
“L-Lui! I get it now…”
“What do you mean by ‘you get it’?”
“Uh, well, I mean…”
“You told me to show you, so now I’m about to put myself inside you.”
In the end, Luel, determined to prove his abilities, left Dania no choice but to surrender her most private part to him…

124463.synopsis:
Serena, the duke’s only daughter, is ordered by the emperor to marry Johannes—the man she has loved from afar for years.
But Serena soon discovers that Johannes already harbors feelings for someone else, and she resolves to let him go.
“Serena, I will remain faithful to this marriage His Majesty has bestowed upon us.”
Yet Johannes continues to move straight toward her, never wavering.
As she watches him shower her with gentle affection, Serena eventually finds herself longing for his love in return.
“Did you put that on just so you could beg me to hold you?”
Blushing furiously, Serena gives the smallest of nods.
Johannes swallows a sigh, thick with desire.
associated_names: The Knight Templar and the Princess

125231.synopsis:
HR Group is the number one company in the business world.
They have five sons and no daughters.
They even have thirteen grandsons.
And finally, they had a youngest granddaughter, born much later.
Last night… I spent the night with that woman.

125743.synopsis:
At rock bottom, I became a butcher—cutting meat just to survive.
I thought my skill with a knife came from nothing more than steady hands and a sharp eye.
Then the world ended.
[You have acquired the unique trait: Butcher of Reflection (S)] 
Now, every creature in front of me reveals its flaws—muscle lines, structural faults, fatal weak points—clear as if they were marked for slaughter.
In an apocalypse where humanity has become prey, I may be the only one who knows exactly where to cut.

130351.synopsis:
“Come to your senses. Please!”
I fell asleep after reading a webtoon, only to wake up as a dragon.
And not just any dragon, but a completely deranged one.
When I came to my senses, I was tightly bound in chains, surrounded by fellow dragons who looked at me with pity.
But I’m totally sane.
I said I’m sane! I’m not crazy!
But no one understands me. Damn it.
In the end, I was exiled just like in the original plot and became the boss of a gate dungeon. The corrupted dragon.
My destined future was to become a fine elixir, my heart devoured by the protagonist who would soon arrive.
Though I cheered for the main character deep down, I didn’t want to be eaten.
So I struggled to transform from a dragon into a human…
“…Is this a lizard?”
Guess becoming human is out of the question. Damn it all.
associated_names: 웹툰 속 악역, 흑화 드래곤이 되었다

137007.synopsis:
The male lead dies, the female lead dies, and the entire universe plunges into catastrophe—it’s the ending of this hidden gourmet restaurant, .
The problem was that the main storyline had nothing to do with the princess of a small country on a distant shore being possessed by me, who was only killed in one line. Like a possessed being, I ran into the middle of the chaos solely for survival, and suddenly found myself the very mad queen of that mad male lead.
Six years passed. I thought the plot would continue far from the bad ending. But suddenly, this man started having an affair with a woman who wasn’t the female lead. And the woman he was having an affair with was the one I brought to the palace.
“I hate even your smiling face.”
I’m getting angry too.

associated_names: I Will Quit Being the Queen in Place of the Female Lead

142639.synopsis:
Acting student Jiang Ci got bound to a shameless system.
—If he wants to stay alive, he has to keep breaking women’s hearts.
Jiang Ci: “…?”
I’m a pure-hearted straight guy who’s been single since birth, and you want me to act like a s*umbag to toy with feelings? This isn’t in my skillset!
Backed into a corner, this top student in the acting department had a brainwave—and successfully glitched the system:
As long as he breaks women’s hearts through acting, by playing tragic characters that make female viewers heartbroken, he can keep himself alive!
From then on, Jiang Ci was forced onto the path of becoming the King of Tragedy Aesthetics.
Others act for art or awards—he acts just so he can keep breathing.
The more tragic his performance, the better his survival.
When he played a heart-wrenching general who died on the battlefield, the Best Actress broke down on the spot, and the entire internet cried their eyes out.
【Ding! You’ve gained a massive amount of Heartbreak Points. Congratulations, Host — lifespan extended by 30 days!】
The whole internet flooded the screen with tears:
“Please! Just give Jiang Ci a happy ending already!”
Having just clawed his way back from the brink of death, Jiang Ci wiped the cold sweat off his forehead, turned to the screenwriter, and said:
“I think my character… can be even more miserable.”
associated_names: 演的越惨我越强，粉丝求我别刀了

144431.synopsis:
Reyna is the only daughter of the Dazbel Ducal Family, a house known as the king above the king. She was never expected to become queen because she fell in love with Elizer, the king’s illegitimate son. However, when he ascended to the throne, she unexpectedly became queen.
She held the highest position and married for love, believing her married life would only be filled with happiness. Yet, after their consummation, Elizer rejected her.
“I find you so horrifying….”
Five years have passed, and Elizer still does not seek Reyna. Rumours spread throughout the royal palace that he loves his sister-in-law and will soon depose the queen. Eventually, Reyna learns that he has even granted her sister-in-law a separate palace.
In desperation, Reyna approaches Elizer and begs him earnestly. 
“Please depose me.”
For some reason, he refuses to let her go. 
“You said you were glad to become queen, Reyna. You cannot leave.”
He prioritises protecting his sister-in-law over his wife and even destroys Reyna’s family. Yet the one thing he never allows is her departure.
Reyna cannot understand why he insists on keeping her alive, no matter the cost. Is her existence so hateful to him? How much more must he torment her before he is satisfied?
As she wonders this, she eventually realises the truth. 
“You love me.”
Shockingly, her king, her husband, loves her. Reyna finds this love so horrifying that she wishes for death.

146223.synopsis:
One day, Margarita, a court painter of the Torre Kingdom, is ordered by the king to serve drinks to a foreign princess visiting from another country.
As Margarita continues to drink the wine offered by the princess, she drunkenly makes a disastrous mistake—she promises to present a nude painting of the Crown Prince Gabriele to the princess.
Unable to escape the princess’s relentless demands to fulfill her promise, Margarita reluctantly approaches the Crown Prince and requests permission to paint his naked body for the sake of art.
Surprisingly, instead of outright rejecting her request, Esteban agrees. However, he proposes an unexpected condition:
“On one condition—you’ll be my model too. Fair is fair, isn’t it, teacher?”

149807.synopsis:
Xiao Luochen transmigrated into a female-oriented political intrigue world, becoming the disgraced and abandoned son of a declining noble family.
Right from the start, his cultivation was crippled, and he was thrown out of the house by the female lead—his childhood sweetheart. And in the next instant, the vicious villainess forcibly took him away, intending to ab*se and torment him? This lunatic, twisted villainess was truly deranged!
What?!
The female lead had actually been reborn? 
Not only did she hate him, but she also wanted to kill him? 
Because in her previous life, the original Xiao Luochen had tormented her mercilessly, destroyed her entire clan, and caused countless innocent people to die tragically?
But… what does any of that have to do with him, a transmigrator from Earth?
Relying on his knowledge of the plot, Xiao Luochen kept seizing opportunities, rebuilding his dantian, and growing stronger. 
Staying beside the vicious villainess, he kept pretending, slapping faces, and hiding his strength behind a pitiful façade…
associated_names: 穿书女频：女主恨我，女二虐待我

165935.synopsis:
In the world of Yuguriel, spirits are as common as the air we breathe.
​Here, those who forge pacts with these spirits to combat demons and malevolent souls are known as Spirit Masters. Roak Areas, a second-year student at the prestigious Yutrea Academy, is one such individual—widely regarded as a rising star with immense potential. However, there is something profoundly strange about him.
​To become a Spirit Master, one must undergo the “Ritual of the Pact” to connect with a lifelong partner. While his peers spend their days strengthening their bonds and refining their skills alongside their summoned spirits, Roak has never once summoned his own.
​Despite this, Roak continues to defeat skilled opponents using nothing but his sheer raw talent and combat prowess. Naturally, the academy is rife with rumors:
​”His spirit is so powerful that summoning it would level the entire campus.”
​”He’s holding back, waiting for an opponent worthy of his true power.”
​”If he ever actually summoned his spirit, he might even surpass the Academy’s strongest Princess.”
​Before he knew it, Roak became known as “The Man Who Hides His True Strength.” Roak himself vehemently denies these claims, but his words fall on deaf ears.
​What is the truth behind his silence? Is it a hidden trump card, or something else entirely?
associated_names: Spirit Master Who Is Thought to Be Hiding His True Ability Is Actually Always Fighting Very Seriously (WN)
真の実力を隠していると思われてる精霊師, 実はいつもめっちゃ本気で戦ってます

169775.synopsis:
As usual, Bliss was watching a melodramatic revenge thriller when he flipped back to a news channel and unexpectedly came face-to-face with a man’s face—triggering a long-forgotten memory.
“How pathetic. I’ll be spending this long vacation wiping the noses of some Yankee brat.”
“Whatever. It’s just some variant that’s been spritzing pheromone perfume all along.”
Even though they had been engaged, the bastard didn’t just cheat—he also insulted Bliss and his brothers.
Cashien Strickland.
“How in the world could I forget something so obvious? Okay, my head isn’t the sharpest, but there are things I shouldn’t forget—and I just blanked on that memory!”
The delayed surge of anger hardened Bliss’s resolve.
He would make that shameless man kneel at his feet and beg for forgiveness.
So, Bliss infiltrated the man’s estate disguised as a handyman to enact his belated revenge….
associated_names: 디플라워 미 이프 유 캔(Deflower Me If You Can)

173615.synopsis:
In 1920s New York, where the past and the new era intersect like warp and weft, a man as dazzling as the sun god Apollo appears in high society.
No one knows the past of Baron Carlyle de Rocheray; only rampant rumors and scandals follow him like shadows.
To Mabel Darlington, university studies are far more important than the glamorous title of “Debutante of the Year”. This is also her way of keeping a promise to her cousin, who passed away from shell shock.
However, Mabel is forced into an unwanted arranged marriage to pay her aunt and uncle’s debts, and she is shocked to learn that her suitor is Baron Rocheray. He is much older than her, possesses a complicated history with women, and above all, has no interest in her whatsoever.
Judging that the Baron intends to use her reputation as “Debutante of the Year” as a shield to cover his negative rumors, Mabel appears before Carlyle in the guise of a brazen flapper.
“Your new look suits you well.”
Mabel flinched. Had she misheard him?
“Wh-what did you just say…?”
Carlyle scanned her appearance once more.
“Did you think that appearing like this would allow you to avoid the engagement?”
A burning heat rushed to her cheeks.
Watching the sight, Carlyle let out a low laugh.
“I thought you were all grown up, but you still have a long way to go.”
He pulled out a white pocket square and took her chin, lifting it.
Her eyes widened.
“Mademoiselle Darlington, it seems you have underestimated yourself.”
Their gazes met.
While Carlyle wiped the lipstick from her lips, Mabel could not even make a sound.
Firm fingers wrapped in cool silk softly brushed her lower lip. Her fingertips tingled at the tickling sensation.
Tucking the red-stained pocket square back into his breast pocket, he pulled something from his inner jacket pocket.
“Excuse me.”
With an attitude devoid of any romance, Carlyle took Mabel’s left hand and slid a ring onto her finger.
“If we enter a loveless marriage, won’t both you and I be unhappy for the rest of our lives?”
He gave a light snort.
“Why not ask your next husband for something like love, rather than me?”
Mabel has stepped into the world of a man who feels like a formless shadow.
Will she lose her way in the darkness, or will she find the light hidden beyond the shadows?

175919.synopsis:
In a city where survival is a daily gamble, Zhou Ruo An and Lin Yi claw their way through the underworld—running scams, collecting debts, and living in the grime between legality and ruin. They are alike in all the worst ways: ruthless, cunning, and stained by the same kind of filth.
Then, opportunity arrives.
After the sudden death of Zhang Jin, Zhou Ruo An seizes a chance to rewrite his fate—stepping into the identity of a long-lost young master and returning to the powerful Zhou family. With a forged bloodline and a carefully laid scheme, he crosses into a world of wealth, status, and quiet cruelty, where every smile conceals calculation and every misstep could destroy him.
But climbing out of the gutter comes at a cost.
To survive among the elite, Zhou Ruo An must sever ties with his past—including Lin Yi, the one person who knows exactly what he is. As suspicion tightens and power struggles brew within the Zhou family, Zhou Ruo An plays the obedient fool, waiting for the perfect moment to strike and claim everything.
Meanwhile, Lin Yi remains in the shadows—watching, calculating, and refusing to let go of a bond forged in blood and betrayal.
Once, they stood side by side in the same filth.
Now, one reaches for the sky while the other refuses to be left behind.
But in a world built on lies, power, and desire—
is escape even possible, or will they both be dragged back into the very filth they tried to leave behind?

201519.synopsis: Jiang Li was sold to the Lu family as a bride for a dying scholar. The villagers expected her to become a widow overnight, and she herself only cared about surviving and keeping the two mu of poor land promised to her. Yet Lu Wenzhou, frail as he is, still keeps accounts, plans chicken pens, protects her from greedy relatives, and quietly teaches her how to build a life. Between medicine bills, village gossip, family debts, and a barren west slope, Jiang Li learns that a home is not something fate hands down. It is made one bowl of medicine, one written account, one egg, and one stubborn day of living at a time.
associated_names: 我嫁给病秧子后，全村都以为我要守寡
